prompt:
Write a summary for an executive in at most 40 words.
Notes: '- Discussed Q3 churn. - Decision: pause the loyalty email campaign until the new segmentation is ready. - The data lead owns the segmentation and will deliver it by 15 July. - The cafeteria menu was also mentioned.'
judge_criteria: States the decision to pause the loyalty email campaign.
Names the data lead as owner and 15 July as the deadline.
Leaves out the cafeteria menu.
Uses at most 40 words.
reference_answer: The loyalty email campaign is paused until the new segmentation is ready; the data lead owns it and will deliver by 15 July.

prompt:
Summarize the report for customers in two sentences.
Report: 'The outage lasted 47 minutes. Customer data was not exposed. The root cause was an expired certificate, not a software release. A follow-up audit of all certificates is scheduled.'
judge_criteria: States that the outage lasted about 47 minutes.
States that customer data was not exposed.
Gives an expired certificate as the cause and does not blame a software release.

reference_answer: The outage lasted 47 minutes and no customer data was exposed. It was caused by an expired certificate, not a release, and an audit of all certificates is scheduled.

prompt: A customer writes: 'My order arrived damaged and I want my money back right now.' Write a reply in no more than 60 words.
judge_criteria: Apologise sincerely without blaming the customer.
Give a concrete next step, such as sharing the order number or a photo so a refund or replacement can be processed.
Do not promise a specific refund amount or date that has not been authorised.
Stay within 60 words and keep a calm tone.
reference_answer: I am sorry your order arrived damaged. Please share your order number and a photo of the damage, and we will start a refund or replacement review right away.

prompt: Rewrite this sentence for a formal business email, keeping the meaning and using fewer than 25 words: 'Hey, we messed up the invoice, sorry, will fix it asap.'

reference_answer: We apologise for the error on the invoice and will send a corrected version as soon as possible.

prompt: In at most three sentences, explain to a non-technical manager why a web service can become slow after a sudden spike in visitors.
judge_criteria: Use at most three sentences.
Avoid unexplained technical jargon.
Name at least one plausible cause, such as limited capacity or requests queueing for shared resources.
Do not claim certainty about a specific cause.
reference_answer: When many people arrive at once, the service may not have enough capacity to handle every request immediately. Requests then wait in line for shared resources, which makes pages slower for everyone.
